newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's mutual funds prefer Koor.
newsitem.headline: Israel's mutual funds prefer Koor.

text.p: The two most popular shares among Israel's mutual funds in March were Koor Industries and Bank Hapoalim, Meitav Investments and Securities said in a report on Sunday.
Other most popular shares were I.D.B Development Corp, Discount Investment Corp and Israel Chemicals, which ranked third, fourth and fifth in preference respectively, the report said.
The survey was made among Israel's nine largest mutual funds, which together held assets totalling 13.6 billion shekels at the end of March, 88 percent of the total assets of mutual funds in Israel.
The report revealed that the nine funds held 154 million shekels worth of Koor stock and 150 million shekels worth of Hapoalim stock.
